## Hicham Randrianarivo

Principal Research Scientist at the [Artefact Research Center](https://www.artefact.com/technologies/artefact-research-center/), Paris, and Associate Researcher at the MICS laboratory, CentraleSupélec (Paris-Saclay).

My full CV is available [as a PDF](_files/www/cv_en.pdf).

I work on LLM-based and generative retrieval — training models to index documents by generating document and semantic IDs — alongside hallucination detection and evaluation protocols for retrieval pipelines.

## Experience

**Principal Research Scientist** — Artefact Research Center, Paris *(Oct 2024 – present)*
: Research on [ArGiMi](https://www.artefact.com/news/le-consortium-argimi-remporte-lappel-a-projet-sur-lintelligence-artificielle-generative-lance-par-bpifrance/), a BPI-funded joint program with Giskard, Mistral AI, INA and BnF building deployable LLM retrieval systems and evaluation assets for enterprise search.
:
    - Continual pretraining (CPT) of the ArGiMi Mistral 24B model.
    - LLM-based retrieval assets under 8B parameters, balancing quality, latency and cost.
    - Generative retrieval: parametric indexing via document/semantic ID generation, and a unified objective that optimises retrieval and generation together.
    - Evaluation datasets and protocols quantifying hallucination and retrieval failure in LLM pipelines.
    - Maintainer of the open-source [`artefactual`](software.qmd) library.

**Associate Researcher** — MICS Laboratory, CentraleSupélec, Paris-Saclay *(Oct 2024 – present)*

**Senior Research Engineer** — Huawei, Amsterdam *(Aug 2022 – Mar 2024)*
: Applied research for Petal Search: multimodal retrieval models and production features.
:
    - Shipped two models: +22% on video classification, +15% on keyword extraction.
    - Multimodal LLM pipelines generating keywords and summaries for video understanding.
    - Led an AI code assistant project on CodeT5 and CodeLlama, including code search and retrieval.
    - Prototyped multi-view 3D reconstruction for object retrieval.

**Research Engineer** — Qwant, Paris *(Jun 2017 – Aug 2022)*
: Image search engine, built and operated end-to-end at 400 QPS over a 15B-document index with 1M updates/day.
:
    - Content-based image retrieval stack with scalable indexing and multimodal embeddings.
    - Co-developed the SnapEarth satellite image search engine (EarthSignature and EarthSearch modules).
    - Initiated and managed a joint project with Graphcore benchmarking IPU inference for retrieval models.

**PhD Student** — ONERA, the French aerospace lab, Paris *(Sep 2012 – Dec 2016)*
: Semantic interpretation of aerial images for large-scale retrieval and indexing: statistical learning with mixtures of object detectors, and shape/structural models for superpixel classification.

**Research Intern** — LIP6, Paris 6 *(2012)*
: Kernel approximation methods enabling linear-time training in high-dimensional spaces for large-scale image classification and retrieval.

**Research Intern** — ETIS, Cergy-Pontoise *(2011)*
: Benchmarking machine learning methods for image retrieval.
